cohort: Women undergoing cesarean section at Izola General Hospital in Slovenia during 2023 (risk-based-only prophylaxis) and 2024 (universal prophylaxis).
finding: Universal antibiotic prophylaxis was independently associated with a reduced risk of surgical site infection (SSI) following cesarean section, although the overall SSI rate did not significantly decline after implementation, and PROM and higher maternal weight were additional independent risk factors.
